asks: Which rules may a driver enforce?
answer: A driver enforces only rules the core issued, identified by a version. Each decision in the record names the version that decided it. A driver that has not yet received the newest version enforces the one it holds, and its decisions name that one; the core sees the difference and issues the newest again, as it does for anything wanted and seen. A driver refuses a version the core did not issue, and a fact says so.

sets.says: A driver enforces only rules the core issued, identified by a version.
